macros.name: nto
macros.doc: \nto{⟨from⟩}{⟨to⟩} takes two arguments and typesets the range from the first to the second, ends inclusive: \nto{3}{4} might yield something like {3, . . . , 4}.

macros.name: setOTMstyle
macros.doc: To select the style, use \setOTMstyle[⟨params⟩]{⟨style⟩}, where style is a style name, and params are style-specific options in a key=val fashion.
